summary: TWO BEDROOM MODERN BUNGALOW We are delighted to bring to the market this lovely fully refurbished two bed home located just outside of the village of Melsonby. The property is set within beautiful scenery in a North Yorkshire village with convenient transport links to Darlington, Richmond & Barnard Castle. Property comprises of; entrance hallway, living room with wood burning fire, modern fully fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, two double bedrooms, bathroom which includes a shower, toilet & basin with a light up mirror. This also benefits from a parking space, and access to the orchard for use. Excludes all bills & council tax. REPOSIT SCHEME AVAILABLE.Ask for details.
